answer: In the simple logistic regression assessing age and camrelizumab treatment response, the coefficient estimate for age is approximately **−0.075 per year of age** (change in log-odds of response per additional year of age; SE 0.024, p ≈ 0.002, n = 80; univariate logistic MLE, response = PR vs. non-response, converged normally). As a separation-robust alternative, a Firth-penalized logistic model adjusting for camrelizumab treatment gives an age coefficient of −0.040 (SE 0.082); the standard multivariable MLE is not identifiable because treatment perfectly separates the response (all 41 camrelizumab patients achieved PR, 0/39 in the comparator arm), driving its coefficients to degenerate values (age ≈ 0 with SE ≈ 1,510).
